findings.title: RTL drop 082af8e ships 9 of 11 blocks: bank_tracker and refresh_ctrl are missing
findings.detail: The 2026-09-17 Frontend drop (git 082af8e) provides RTL and manifests for wb_port, addr_decoder, cmd_queue, scheduler, cmd_gen, init_fsm, calibration, config_regs and data_path, but no bank_tracker.sv or refresh_ctrl.sv and no manifests for them under Frontend/OutputFolders. Copies exist only under Frontend/failedattemptlog/, which validation does not read. Every integration path that instantiates the scheduler requires both blocks (integration_map requires: scheduler -> cmd_queue, bank_tracker, refresh_ctrl), so 17 of 20 paths cannot be built from this drop alone. Validation is temporarily taking the two blocks from a snapshot of the previous complete drop (dce7b40, kept under Validation/rtl_snapshots/) and stamping that provenance into every run report. Please regenerate the two blocks into Frontend/OutputFolders so the drop is self-contained. Separately, the drop tree now contains 79 demo / failed-attempt copies of block RTL beside the canonical output; validation now resolves blocks only through declared drop roots (Validation/spec/rtl_drop.json) so those copies cannot be picked up by mistake.
findings.resolution: Frontend drop b4d6f45 (2026-09-17) adds bank_tracker.sv and refresh_ctrl.sv with manifests under Frontend/OutputFolders/PHASE2RTL and VALIDATIONREPORT/lint_combined. Both are byte-identical to the dce7b40 copies validation had been using, so no re-validation was needed. The snapshot root was removed from Validation/spec/rtl_drop.json and Validation/rtl_snapshots/ deleted.
